title: Harary–Hill conjecture
statement: For every n, the crossing number of K_n equals floor(n/2)·floor((n−1)/2)·floor((n−2)/2)·floor((n−3)/2)/4.

counterexample.description: A general-position rational straight-line drawing of some K_n with fewer crossings than the Harary–Hill value; K_13 with at most 224 crossings is the first unresolved target.
